name: Moratorium ~Blue Hour Shiawase no Jikan~
original_name: モラトリアム ～ブルーアワー幸せの時間～
source:
One day during the new semester, while walking near his college, the protagonist encountered a foreign girl being pick-up by a group of men. The girl seemed depressed and looked like she was asking for help, however, the protagonist began scolding her. The girl was surprised and started refuting him as well, while the men were left shocked and then dispersed.

Afterwards, he went to a bookstore in his college. When he found the book he was looking for, at that moment, another foreign girl reached for that book, and they ended up having an argument. In the end, he could not get the book he wanted and decided to go home. Whether it was a coincidence or not, on that day before returning home, he had been offended by two foreign girls.

At a later date, he was contacted by his college and went to the student center.

To his surprise, he was asked to let two new foreign students stay at his house, which has been registered as a dormitory. The two foreign girls were Misha, who was being pick-up by a group of men, and Adelina, who got into an argument with him at the bookstore.

At first, the protagonist refused, however, after learning that they had no place to stay, he reconsidered. He decided to let them stay at his house, but with conditions.......

[Translated and edited from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1249762]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
新学期的某一天，主人公在大学附近散步时，撞见一名外国少女正被一群男人纠缠搭讪。少女神色局促，看上去像是在向旁人求助，谁知主人公走上前去反倒数落起了她。少女既错愕又不服气地开口反驳，而那群搭讪的男人则被这突如其来的一幕搞得目瞪口呆，随后悻悻散去。

事后，主人公走进大学里的书店。就在他找到心仪书籍、准备伸手去拿的那一刻，另一名外国少女也同时伸手去够同一本书，两人因此争执了起来。结果他没能买到想要的书，只得动身回家。不知是不是巧合，这天回家前，他接连在两名外国少女那里惹了一肚子不痛快。

几天后，主人公接到学校通知前往学生中心。

令他大吃一惊的是，校方竟拜托他收留两名新来的外国留学生，让她们住进他那栋登记为学生宿舍的自家住宅里。而这两名外国少女不是别人，正是不久前被男人们纠缠搭讪的米莎，以及在书店里与他发生争执的阿德莉娜。

起初主人公断然拒绝，可在得知两人实在无处容身后，他还是改了主意，同意让她们住进自己家里——只不过附带了条件……

[编译自[url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1249762]Getchu[/url]]
